The following actions will give a chance to drop this pet:
• completing a dungeon floor
• during an elite dungeon
• doing the Dungeoneering Hole activity at The Beach
The following actions will not give a chance to drop this pet:
• unlocking a resource dungeon
• playing a Minigame that rewards experience in this skill
• using a Dungeoneering skill training dummy

Gaining this item is based on the amount of experience awarded at once; the more experience granted per floor, the greater the chance of gaining this pet. The chance is not affected by experience boosters.
In a purely mathematical format, the chance f of receiving the pet on any particular action is
f = \frac{(B / 25) \times S}{50,000,000 \times P}
Where:
• B is the base experience per action
• P is the party size
• S is the virtual skill level. At 200 million experience, a flat bonus of 200 is applied to this value
The highest chance of unlocking Gordie is through doing solo large floors at 200M Dungeoneering XP.
